_comment: Scenes of the reference clip and the game shot that answers each: frame of docs/reference/frames, game query, hour, seconds of play, inspect camera (alpha,beta,radius,height above the ship's centre; alpha "@a" relative to the heading, @0 astern), optional script run every frame (shot.mjs SHOT_SCRIPT), optional `before` run once before the shot with 15 s of frames after it (SHOT_BEFORE). tools/shots/reference-sheet.mjs <out-dir> [scene ...].

stern-castle.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); if (!globalThis.__run) { globalThis.__run = 1; s.command({ type: "course", ship: me.id, heading: s.env.windDirection }); }

deck.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); if (me.ship.sailTarget[0] !== 2) s.command({ type: "sails", ship: me.id, mast: "all", level: 2 });

quarter-close.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); if (!globalThis.__run) { globalThis.__run = 1; s.command({ type: "course", ship: me.id, heading: s.env.windDirection }); }

underwater.before: const c=b.renderer.camera; if (c.cine) { for (const [k, v] of [["t", 22.45], ["angle", -1.45], ["y", -2.5], ["tilt", 0.6]]) Object.defineProperty(c.cine, k, { get: () => v, set: () => {} }); }
